instruction: The interior of an astronomical observatory dome: a large refractor telescope on a massive equatorial mount aimed through the open dome slit at a starry sky, a control desk with glowing dials, star charts pinned to the curved wall, a catwalk ring, bookcases and a ladder. The dome slit reveals the Milky Way while the telescope slowly tracks.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Observatory Dome Interior. The interior of an astronomical observatory dome: a large refractor telescope on a massive equatorial mount aimed through the open dome slit at a starry sky, a control desk with glowing dials, star charts pinned to the curved wall, a catwalk ring, bookcases and a ladder. The dome slit reveals the Milky Way while the telescope slowly tracks. Style: scientific stylized realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
